characters.name: Etsy Penelope Sochi
characters.role: daughter pit bull (first, middle, last name)
characters.visual_notes: Main character. Full name: Etsy Penelope Sochi (first, middle, last). From reference photo batch: short smooth coat that reads blue-fawn/grayish-tan as a puppy and warmer tan/fawn as an adult; white chest patch; white on paws; white chin/muzzle markings especially as a pup; broad bully-breed head; dark eyes; black nose; ears rose/semi-erect as adult. Daughter of Smoky (aka Smoking) and Fat Girl. Likeness not yet human-approved for final art lock.

characters.name: Smoky
characters.role: father pit bull (dad of Etsy Penelope Sochi)
characters.visual_notes: Aka Smoking. Blue/charcoal gray ("blue") short coat; broad blocky bully-breed head; dark eyes; black nose; natural rose/floppy ears; white chest/throat patch; white socks on front paws; small white blaze sometimes visible on forehead. Muscular, stocky American Bully / pit-bull type. Often seen resting, on the porch, or napping with Fat Girl. Parent-batch refs imported 2026-10-04.

characters.name: Fat Girl
characters.role: mother pit bull (mom of Etsy Penelope Sochi)
characters.visual_notes: Tan/fawn short coat; stocky muscular bully-breed build; broad head; dark eyes; black nose; rose/semi-erect ears; white chest/neck patch; white on paws; white facial blaze on muzzle/forehead. Warm tan body with darker shading around muzzle. Appears in cozy family scenes with Smoky and daughter Etsy Penelope Sochi. Parent-batch refs imported 2026-10-04.

characters.name: Luna
characters.visual_notes: From 5 adult reference photos (2026-10-04): solid black short dense coat; domestic shorthair; large round yellow-green/gold eyes with vertical pupils; black nose; long thin whiskers (some catch light as lighter); pointed upright ears; rounded broad face; medium stocky build. Often nestled in cozy blankets/pillows. One photo shows a temporary shaved patch on a front leg (vet site) — omit from coloring-book likeness unless operator requests it. Likeness not yet human-approved for final art lock.

characters.name: Coco
characters.visual_notes: From 4 photos provisionally tagged as Coco: fawn/tan short coat; brachycephalic flat wrinkled face; large upright bat-like ears; dark eyes and nose; often nestled among plush toys and cozy blankets. Operator should confirm these tags vs Etsy adult shots before likeness lock.
